title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: a seed record that leaves a key field blank is refused at load
body:
Fixes #34857
Also delivers (folded, closed by the area at close-out): #35336, #35376

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #35480 — skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md (:48 the externalId row, :68 the composite key, :93 externalId selection: none says a record must carry every key field or is refused at load)

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：种子数据里某条记录缺了用来识别它的键值（比如没填名称），以前每次启动、安装或升级都会悄悄多插一行；现在这一条不再写入，加载结果写明是哪个对象的第几条、缺哪个字段、怎么改，其余数据照常加载。另外「同一对象有两个兜底语种集」的报错不再提已经不存在的「进程内升级」原因。
- 为什么做：安装、升级与启动可靠性（种子数据生命周期）；修的是作者自写种子每次加载重复插行且无提示的问题。
- 出错会怎样：故意留空键值的作者，这条记录在新环境里不再出现（以前是每次多一行）；已经重复的行不会被清理；撤回本次合并即可恢复旧行为。
- 要你做什么：无。

## 席位核对

### What changes

Ruling B1 (record 7000515976), extended to single-field keys (record 7000600379).

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts`: in `loadDataset`'s record loop, for the keyed modes (`ignore`, `upsert`, `update`), a record that leaves a field of its `externalId` blank (`undefined`, `null` or `''`; any component of a composite key, or the single field, `name` by default) is refused: `errored++`, one `ReferenceResolutionError` (`field` = the blank field(s), `targetField: '(externalId)'`, `recordIndex`), one `logger.error` per dataset (none on a dry run), `continue`. The check sits where the authored key is read: after `resolveSeedRecord` (expressions) and the organization stamp, BEFORE any reference resolves, so a deferred reference (#34800 / #34856) still holds its authored value and is never caught. The blank rule is the one `seedLandedKey` / `externalIdKey` already key `''` by, now one helper `isBlankSeedKeyValue`; whitespace is a value (A3, unchanged).
- A2 choice: the per-record refusal REPLACES the #28952 dataset-level `warn`. That warn said "every record is written as a new row, on every load", which is false once nothing is written, and a dataset-level line on top of per-record errors would report the same records twice. The per-record message carries the #28952 prescription too (key the dataset on fields every record carries, a list, or `'id'`). The boot log says it once per dataset.
- `findDuplicateFallbackSets` (#35376, PR #35374 merged 2026-11-19T08:44Z before this PR opened): refusal text and docblock name only the cause that still arises, two packages marking one object.
- Docs `content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx`: Import Modes states the rule; the composite-key section says every listed field is carried; the `TestUser` example (records with no `name`) gains `externalId: 'email'` (A4); the fallback bullet drops the stale in-process-upgrade cause (#35376).
- ADR-0087 ledger entry `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.seed-key-blank-record-refused.ts` (data only, no export, no Zod change; authorized by the PM for this narrowing), marked `registered seed-key-blank-record-refused` in the changeset.

### Tests

New pins (shared-harness rule, top-level describes in existing harness files):

- `seed-loader-empty-key-warn.test.ts`: composite key with one component `''` / `null` / omitted (three loads: 2, 2, 2 rows; error names object, index 1, field `sku`, fix), single-field `sku`, default `name` through a parsed request (`SeedLoaderRequestSchema.parse`, no `externalId`: the message reads "keyed on externalId 'name' (also the key a dataset gets when it names none) and leaves 'name' blank"), CONTROL an authored `name`+`sku` key gets no such hint, an expression evaluating empty (`os.user.id`) refused, `update` reports instead of skipping silently, dry run reports and logs nothing, CONTROL fully keyed dataset converges and says nothing, CONTROL whitespace-only value is a value. The #28952 describe flips: every record refused, one error each, one line per dataset, no `warn`.
- `seed-loader-deferred-key-reference.test.ts`: CONTROL `ignore` and `upsert`, a deferred key reference is not refused, three loads one row; CONTROL a key reference authored `''` beside it is refused. The #34856 delete describe in the same file stays green.

Fixture triage (what each pinned is kept):

- `seed-loader-deferred-dropped.test.ts` (reverse pin): its keyless device was a blank `region` in a keyed dataset, now refused. Remade, not deleted: the department dataset names no `mode` and the load config no `defaultMode` (a request built without the parse's defaults, the one load that still writes a row keyed `''`), so pass-2 write-back by captured id stays pinned on a written keyless row. Added: the KEYED blank-component record is refused before it writes or defers anything.
- `seed-loader-pointer-pair.test.ts`: `insertSeed` keyed on `id` with no ids now gives each record its id; the KEYLESS heal case moves to the same mode-less device.
- `seed-loader-composite-key-diagnostic.test.ts`: the ruling's pair `('a','b')` / `('a\0b','')` — the second is now refused, still never matched to the first.
- `protocol.seed-external-id-refusal.test.ts`: the `externalId: 'id'` control's record carries an id.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-seed-required-deferral.test.ts`: datasets with no `externalId` (default `name`) and no `name` get `externalId: 'process_name'` / `'action'`; the KEYLESS heal case uses the mode-less device.
- `packages/runtime/src/seed-loader.test.ts`: "should handle records with no matching externalId field" pinned the insert; flipped to the refusal.
- `seed-loader-locale-scope.test.ts`: #35376's pin follows the new text.

### Acceptance notes

- A1 (measured on 35c63310 with a copy of the base loader, three loads each): single `code` 2, 3, 4 rows, 0 warn, 0 error; default `name` 2, 3, 4; composite `''` 2, 3, 4; composite `null` (`ignore`) 2, 3, 4. With the fix: 1, 1, 1 and one error per load.
- Stock: the dogfood battery boots every example app; zero blank-key refusals in its log.
- Departs from PR #29066's seat route ("the boot loader never refuses"), by the maintainer's ruling. A boot still does not fail (`haltOnError: false`).
- The mode-less load (no `mode`, no `defaultMode`) is left unkeyed on purpose; nothing in this PR changes it.
- Not changed: rows earlier loads duplicated stay.
- `seed-loader-locale-scope.test.ts` "an upgrade that changed the marked set (versions 1 and 2 on one list)" still feeds both versions straight to the loader; its comment describes the pre-#35374 replay list. Left as is: the loader still refuses that input from a direct caller.

### Verification

All readings on head `755c75a5` (the fold commit `64abfecd`, one merge of `origin/main` `a9b36eff`, the #35376 commit) unless named.

<details><summary>Tests and typecheck</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: `Test Files  358 passed | 9 skipped (367)`, `Tests  23238 passed | 45 skipped (23283)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol --filter @objectstack/runtime --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck`: exit 0.
- Re-keyed consumer files: runtime `src/seed-loader.test.ts src/seed-datasets.test.ts src/app-plugin.seed-locale-producer.test.ts` `Tests  93 passed (93)`; objectql `src/engine-seed-required-deferral.test.ts` `Tests  7 passed (7)`.
- Consumer sweep on `64abfecd`'s tree (dist rebuilt): every test file outside this package that names the seed loader or authors seed records, run in runtime (36 files), objectql (26), cloud-connection (26), rest (10), metadata (4), plugins/organizations (5), cli unit tier (3): all green after the two re-keyed files above; integration-tier cli files declared to CI.
- Dogfood battery (narrowing arm), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` after the `@objectstack/dogfood^...` build, on `755c75a5`: `Test Files  482 passed | 3 skipped (485)`, `Tests  4092 passed | 68 skipped (4160)`, lock verdict `command-exit 0`; zero blank-key refusals in the boot logs.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (restored, blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

- `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `seed-loader.ts`: `const blankKeyFields = [...keyFields].filter(...)` replaced by `const blankKeyFields: string[] = [];` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `b10e9f2e` to `23591f6e`). `seed-loader-empty-key-warn.test.ts` + `seed-loader-deferred-key-reference.test.ts`: `Tests  11 failed | 22 passed (33)`; the 11 are every refusal pin, the 22 include every CONTROL. Restored: blob `b10e9f2e` equals HEAD. No build involved: the pins import `./seed-loader.js` from source.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 117 families (the diff touches `packages/spec`). Run locally on `755c75a5`, all exit 0: `check-adr-0087-registration` (with `--self-test`; reads `registered seed-key-blank-record-refused (new here)`), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:durability-log-level`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:doc-anchors`, `check:docs-single-h1`, `check:doc-frontmatter`, `check:startup-registry-verdict`, `check:engine-double-contract`, `docs-audit/check-affected-docs`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:test-source-alias`, spec `check:upgrade-guide`, spec `check:spec-changes`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:type-check-debt`, `check:dts-closure`. The other derived families are declared to CI (`--ran`: 21 run, the rest UNRUN locally).
- `overlap-check.mjs --branch=HEAD`: `VERDICT clean exit 0` (shares one test file with open PR #35388, merges cleanly).

</details>
